text:
Alex S: Heads up — HaloMed onboarding is stuck. Customer reporting frequent embed fetch timeouts and session churn during walkthroughs. Renewal at risk if we don't stabilize by EOW.
Priya R: Ugh, timeline's tight. Any errors/logs from support?
Alex S: Pasting the most recent failure from their repro:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"input":"patient note..."}'```Response 504 after ~12s, sometimes 502. Happens across model variants.
Jordan L: :eyes: Could be our edge LB or the KV cache warmup pattern. Sam, did Dedicated infra show any throttles for their tenant yesterday?
Sam T: Checked dedicated metrics — no quota triggers, but there were frequent short-lived pod restarts on region-us-west-2 around 11:20-11:35 UTC correlated with node OOM kills. I have the kube events snippet.
Alex S: Attaching excerpt from the user session timeline: "embed request -> 504 -> client retries -> duplicate sessions -> onboarding UI shows blank". They tried switching to lower batch sizes — no improvement.
Priya R: Key asks for CS handoff: 1) Stabilize embed endpoint or provide safe fallback UI 2) Short comms to HaloMed CSM and CSM+AM 3) Run a brief repro window with SRE and customer present 4) Proactive credit/waiver if SLA hit
Jordan L: Proposed triage steps: a) Verify runtime kernel selection logs around those requests b) Check prefix/KV cache hits for that tenant c) Add short-term routing policy to route HaloMed embeds to warm pool in us-east for testing
Sam T: I can pin them to warm pool for a 1-hour window. Will do if we agree.
Alex S: Please do. Also need someone to draft the comms paragraph we send to the customer now. They already pinged their AM this morning.
Priya R: I'll draft. Suggest: short apology, summary of steps, expected ETA for next update (2-3 hours), and invite to repro session. Keep it empathetic and offer temporary workaround (switch to reranking+structured prompts) if acceptable.
Jordan L: I'll collect runtime logs and kernel traces; pushing a temporary route to warm pool now. If we still see 504s after routing, we'll enable detailed request-level tracing for that tenant (toggle in Console -> Tracing).
ops-bot: [auto] Ticket #HLM-3487 created for escalation: priority=P1, owner=customer-success. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/HLM-3487
Sam T: Warm pool pin applied at 1746602560. Monitoring tail latency.
Alex S: Update from HaloMed: they joined a quick screen-share, saw 1 successful embed after the pin, then a 502 on the next attempt.
Priya R: Action items (assignments): - Priya R: draft customer comms + send to AM (ETA 30m) - Jordan L: gather runtime logs + enable tracing if failures persist (ETA 45m) - Sam T: monitor warm pool and revert if side effects (ETA 1h) - Alex S: coordinate repro session and collect UX screenshots (ongoing)
Jordan L: Found increased GC cycle logs and slow memcpy on host gpu-12 around failure times. Sending snippet in thread:```[2026-02-14T11:22:13Z] worker-3 kernel-select: quantized path fallback -> memcpy 220ms; kvcache-miss 1.2s``` Might explain 12s tail.
Priya R: I'm prepping the comms now. Draft: "Hi Emily — we're investigating an intermittent embed timeout impacting your onboarding flows. Our engineers are pinning your traffic to a warm pool and collecting traces; next update in ~2 hours. We've scheduled a quick repro session — can you join at 15:30 PT?" Thoughts?
Alex S: Looks good. Please include the offer of a one-time service credit if they experience >5% failure rate this week.
Priya R: Added. Sending to AM now.
Sam T: Warm pool stats: tail latency dropped from 9-12s to 1.8-3.5s for ~70% of requests after pin. Still seeing rare spikes. I'm keeping the pin for 2h and will capture heap/gpu metrics.
Jordan L: Plan B if spikes persist: 1) temporary fallback to smaller model variant for embeds 2) throttle client retries at edge 3) schedule a maintenance window for deeper runtime changes
Alex S: Can we prepare the fallback route config and rollback plan? I want to avoid surprise on the customer call.
Jordan L: Yes — I'll prepare a runbook (short) and post link here.
Priya R: Customer comms sent. AM replied :thumbsup: and confirmed Emily can join the 15:30 PT repro.
Alex S: Great. Keeping this P1 until 1746605968. Will update thread after repro. Thanks team.
Sam T: Noted — will post metrics snapshot after 30m.
Jordan L: Uploaded initial logs to the ticket. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/HLM-3487/attachments
Alex S: Closing interim update — repro set for 1746605400, will follow with outcomes.
Priya R: +1. Follow-ups: capture customer feedback on fallback UX, record any ask for docs/enablement to prevent churn.
Jordan L: If we need config changes, suggest CS ops runbook entry to include "embed warm-pool pin" steps.
Sam T: Copy that.
ops-bot: [auto] Reminding owners to update ticket HLM-3487 with postmortem if incident stays open >72h."
